text: Requisitos de admisión: Foreign nationals in good health. A bachelor degree or degree of higher education background. Under 65 years of age; exceptions can be considered for applicants with competitive academic background or those recommended by collaborative universities. There are no minimal Chinese language requirements for those who apply for programs taught in English or Japanese. Non-native English speakers must score at least 90 points in TOEFL exam or 6.5 points in IELTS exam for the programs taught in English. Applicants without TCM background must hold a degree on medicine or related science and are expected to have abilities of self-study and conducting academic research.
